title: 第十五章 劳逸结合第十六章 考考你的
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 以她现有高冷师尊的比格与人设来看，这饼，她接不得。
但若是将这半块干饼看作是男主段莫弃主动递来的“尊重”，与“友谊见证”，那这饼，她不能不接！
而且……这小子不也给了自己个台阶，说是“查查”他服用的食物吗？
那光用灵识探查不够全面，放进嘴里细细品鉴也是理所应当的吧？
‘嗯，没错。’解清玄当即点头，接过干饼，径直放在嘴里咬下一口。
干嚼两下，艰难下肚，这下又轮到她汗流浃背了。
‘这很难评。’
解清玄不得不承认，这干饼味道感人，口感磨人，她被各色现代美食养刁了的灵魂，即使饿了十年，也还是无法接受这种食物！
她看着手中剩下的巴掌大小的干饼，只觉得情况变得更加尴尬了。
‘扔，还是不扔，这是第二个问题。’
这难以下咽的迷之食物她是一口都不想往嘴里放了。但直接扔掉又太不礼貌了……
解清玄不动声色地瞥向段莫弃。他若无其事地边烧水沏茶，边就着茶水啃剩下的干饼，但他的目光依旧集中在解清玄身上，仿佛也还在好奇她的后续举动。
灵光一闪，解清玄想到借口了。
她淡然抬手，直接将那半块干饼碾碎为粉尘，随后维持着原主那高冷比格抬眼看向段莫弃：“小段啊，在师尊这里修习的几月你就打算靠这种东西度日了？如此粗简杂物入体恐怕会引浊气入体，拖累你的修为啊？”
他暗叹一声‘着实麻烦’，面上却赶忙低头道歉：“弟子愚钝，未曾注意到这些细节。还望师尊指教！”
段莫弃十年间未曾系统辟谷，每天至少要吃上一顿。流云主峰脚下有专门为筑基以下内外门弟子设立的食堂，每周开放一天，供未辟谷的弟子前往囤货。
于是，解清玄将段莫弃支去洞府静修，自己则主动提出要替他去食堂取干粮。她可以借此机会探一探流云宗的地形，也好偷偷满足一下自己的口腹之欲。
“为师去去就来。”她一甩道袍，起身上剑，出了仙府。
望着她离去的背影，段莫弃眼中的感激与赤诚一点点熄灭，转而变得晦涩难懂不知所想。
片刻飞行，解清玄按着【流云手册】所指来到谷中食堂小院。
许是过了饭点，堂内空空荡荡，并没有弟子门人正在用餐。只有几个外门弟子正在后厨慢慢吞吞地收拾烹饪餐具，打扫卫生。
见也没什么好参观的，解清玄与管事大叔知会一声，便开始又吃又拿，将今日所剩菜品都包了圆儿。
管事大叔和几个小徒弟此前从未见过这位仙人之姿的长老，却也是头一次见有人可以顶着如此风轻云淡的面容一脸高深莫测地做出如此有失风度有违身份的事……
content_en:
Judging from her current personality and personality as a cold master, she cannot accept this pie.
But if this half piece of dry biscuit is regarded as "respect" and "witness of friendship" offered by the male protagonist Duan Mo Qi, then she has to accept this biscuit!
Moreover... didn't this kid also give himself a step by saying to "check" the food he takes?
So just using spiritual sense to detect it is not comprehensive enough, so it is natural to put it in your mouth and taste it carefully, right?
'Well, that's right. ’ Xie Qingxuan nodded immediately, took the dry biscuit, put it in his mouth and took a bite.
After chewing twice and swallowing with difficulty, it was her turn to sweat profusely.
'This...'
'It's hard to comment. ’
Xie Qingxuan had to admit that the taste of this dry biscuit was touching and the texture was abrasive. Her soul, which had been fed by all kinds of modern delicacies, could not accept this kind of food even after ten years of hunger!
She looked at the palm-sized dry biscuits left in her hands and felt that the situation had become even more embarrassing.
‘To throw or not to throw, that is the second question. ’
She didn't want to put a bite of this unpalatable food into her mouth. But it would be too rude to just throw it away...
Jie Qingxuan glanced at Duan Moqi calmly. He boiled water and made tea as if nothing had happened, and ate the remaining dry biscuits with the tea, but his eyes were still focused on Jie Qingxuan, as if he was still curious about her next move.
With a flash of inspiration, Xie Qingxuan thought of an excuse.
She raised her hand indifferently and crushed the half piece of dry biscuit into dust. Then she raised her eyes to look at Duan Moqi while maintaining the coldness of the original owner: "Xiao Duan, how many months have you been practicing with the master and you plan to live on this kind of thing? I'm afraid that such simple and simple things will attract turbidity into the body and drag down your cultivation?"
Duan Moqi: "..."
He secretly sighed, "It's really troublesome," but he quickly bowed his head and apologized: "My disciple is stupid and has not noticed these details. I hope Master can give me some advice!"
Duan Moqi had not systematically gone without grains in ten years and had to eat at least one meal every day. At the foot of the main peak of Liuyun, there is a canteen specially set up for the inner and outer disciples below Zhuji. It is open one day a week for the disciples who have not yet become bigu to stock up.
So, Xie Qingxuan sent Duan Mo to the cave to retreat, and he offered to go to the canteen to get dry food for him. She could take this opportunity to explore the terrain of Liuyun Sect, or secretly satisfy her appetite.
"Come back as soon as you go as a master." She shook off her Taoist robe, stood up, drew her sword, and left the immortal mansion.
Looking at her leaving back, the gratitude and sincerity in Duan Moqi's eyes extinguished little by little, and became obscure and hard to understand.
…
After a short flight, Xie Qingxuan arrived at the small courtyard of the canteen in the valley according to the instructions in the "Liuyun Manual".
Perhaps it was past meal time, but the hall was empty, with no disciples eating. Only a few outer disciples were slowly putting away cooking utensils and cleaning in the back kitchen.
Seeing that there was nothing to see, Xie Qingxuan and the uncle in charge informed him, and then started eating and picking up, wrapping up all the leftover dishes today.
The uncle in charge and several young apprentices had never seen this immortal-like elder before, but it was also the first time they saw someone with such a calm and indifferent face and an unfathomable expression doing something so unbecoming and contrary to his identity...
